questions.q: What does the Web activity do?
options: Pauses the pipeline for a specified duration
Sets the value of a pipeline variable
Calls a custom REST endpoint from inside a pipeline
Deliberately fails the pipeline with a custom message
questions.explain: Web activity can call GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE against a custom REST endpoint, optionally passing datasets and linked services along with the request.

questions.q: What does the Wait activity do?
options: Retries a failed activity automatically
Waits for user approval before running
Pauses the pipeline for a specified number of seconds before continuing
Delays only the very first activity in a pipeline
questions.explain: Wait does exactly one thing: pause execution for a set number of seconds, useful for waiting out a known external delay or spacing out retries deliberately.

questions.q: Why would a pipeline builder deliberately add a Fail activity?
options: To stop the pipeline loudly, with a clear custom message, when a condition that should be true isn't
Fail activities are only added by accident and should always be removed
To automatically retry a failed Copy activity
To make a pipeline run faster
questions.explain: Paired with an If Condition checking something that should be true (like a row count above zero), Fail lets a pipeline stop with a clear explanation rather than silently "succeeding" on bad data.

questions.q: What does the Set Variable activity do?
options: Creates a brand-new linked service
Sets the value of an already-defined pipeline variable
Deletes a pipeline parameter
Defines a new dataset's schema
questions.explain: Set Variable writes a value into a pipeline variable that's already been defined at the pipeline level, so a later activity can read it back — Chapter 4 covers variables in full depth.

questions.q: What authentication options does the Web activity support?
options: Basic, Client Certificate, Service Principal, and Managed Identity
Only anonymous access, with no authentication options at all
Only a shared access signature
Only account key authentication
questions.explain: Web activity supports the same broad range of identity options as many connectors — Basic, Client Certificate, Service Principal, and Managed Identity.
